description: Latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99/max, ms) per API resource (API + method + resource template) in a time window, slowest p95 first. Use for 'what is slow', 'latency outliers', 'p95/p99'.

configuration.query: FROM apim_event_response | WHERE DATE_DIFF("minute", requestTimestamp, NOW()) <= ?lookback_minutes | STATS calls=COUNT(*), p50_ms=PERCENTILE(responseLatency, 50), p95_ms=PERCENTILE(responseLatency, 95), p99_ms=PERCENTILE(responseLatency, 99), max_ms=MAX(responseLatency) BY apiName, apiMethod, apiResourceTemplate | EVAL p95_ms=ROUND(p95_ms), p99_ms=ROUND(p99_ms) | SORT p95_ms DESC | LIMIT 20

lookback_minutes.description: How far back to look, in minutes (e.g. 60 for the last hour, 1440 for a day).
